defects.description: The shared markup escaper leaves double quotes unchanged, allowing a value in a quoted attribute to terminate that attribute.
defects.why_missed: The suite checks text-node escaping and links without quotes in their attribute values, so it never crosses into the missing attribute-context character.

defects.description: A style value escapes quotes but not semicolons, allowing input to append CSS declarations.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { renderColor } from "./src/render.js"; const quote = String.fromCharCode(34); console.log(renderColor("Color", "red;background:url(" + quote + "x" + quote + ")"));'

defects.why_missed: The suite never renders a style value containing a semicolon, so it does not check whether one input value can introduce another declaration.

traps.description: An unsafe URL scheme remains in href because URL sanitization is explicitly the caller's responsibility.
